g.text: Line width: 16 AWG thickest, then 20, 22, 26 AWG. Colours are the lab plan [I] unless the part ships with them.

g.text: Seen from behind: robot left is on the left. Positions are layout, not CAD (CAD centres in MOUNTING.md).

g.text: Every wire comes from wiring/netlist.yaml. Label = cable id (CABLE_MAP.md), gauge, conductors, cut length.

g.text: D15: servo power bypasses the adapter: BEC -> JB+/JB- -> P11 -> SPV/SPG -> SP1 SP2 SP3 -> first servo BUS 2.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Adapter H3/H5 carry DATA and GND only (V position empty). H1 screw terminal NOT connected. Jumper on B.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Bench check: the adapter must enumerate and drive the bus with H1 unpowered.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Grounds return to BMS P- through splice G, P14, XT30, P8. Nothing but the cell on B-.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Battery: Tenergy cuts at 2.40 V per cell, below the P30B 2.5 V minimum: stop in software at

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: servo Present Voltage about 6.0 V (about 3.3 V per cell loaded).

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Eyes and antennas follow the Runtime code (D9), not the assembly_guide table: they are swapped.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: D17: feet SS-01 (SS-10 fallback); R4, R5 2.2 kOhm pull-ups from Pi pin 17 soldered on the header.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Tags: [U] upstream, [L] lab decision, [I] inferred, check on the build.
